Priya L.: quick note: devs found short base64 strings in staging bundle uploads (gs://staging-sw/2026-05-02.tar.gz). looks like IVs or small nonces.
Marco (infra): thanks. can you paste an example line?
Priya L.: `...meta:{nonce:\"MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ==\"}, service: backup-agent`
Sana (sec): treat as sensitive. immediate triage: list affected objects, suspend backup pushes, rotate agent service account keys, tighten bucket IAM.
Marco (infra): flipping IAM to group:backup-ops only and disabling the scheduled cron push.
OpsBot: IAM change applied: storage.objectViewer removed from domain:devs@redwood-inference. object push cron disabled (job id: cron-824).
Sana (sec): scan suggestion: grep for \"nonce\" or \"iv\" in logs and run base64-length filter. I'll run a quick pattern scan across last 60 days.
Priya L.: repo check: backup-agent logs nonce when DEBUG=true. helm staging values had DEBUG set.
Marco (infra): will patch helm values to set DEBUG=false and redeploy. also creating new KMS wrap key and scheduling rewrap window.
Sana (sec): create ticket SEC-981 and attach audit export. keep external partners on hold until we confirm scope.
Priya L.: initial scan found 5 objects, all staging-only. proceeding with purge of latest versions and opening GCS support ticket for older versions.
Marco (infra): purge kicked off. rewrap plan: create wrap-staging-2026-05, update agent, re-run backups in maintenance window.
Sana (sec): TL;DR: leakage due to debug logging; containment steps in progress: purge, RBAC tighten, key rotation, CI lint to prevent DEBUG=true in non-prod helm values. Closing once SEC-981 fully documented.
